question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**have been exposed**" indicates past and present exposure to the chemicals. (प्रभावित किया गया है)
 
• In the context of the passage, the rodents have been exposed to the chemicals and then are fed upon by natural pest controllers.
 
• The other options: "**had**," "**have**," and "**has been**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Even if not consumed directly, by feeding on rodents that have been__ exposed to these poisonous chemicals, these natural pest controllers in our backyards are (5) ___________ grave risk.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Had (था)**: is used to express possession in the past tense.
 
• **Have (है)**: is used to express possession in the present tense and does not fit the passive form needed here.
 
• **Has been (हुआ है)**: is the singular form of the present perfect passive voice, but "rodents" is plural.
